description_en: You can call the DescribeDcdnUserConfigs operation to query configurations related to security features
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnUserConfigs查询安全功能相关的配置
name: DescribeDcdnUserConfigs

parameters.description_en:
The configuration to query. You can query the following configurations:

- domain\_business\_control: User configurations.

- bot\_basic: Bot Traffic Management Basic Edition (legitimate web crawlers and threat intelligence).

- bot\_Advance: Bot Traffic Management Pro (legitimate web crawlers, threat intelligence, and AI-powered protection).
parameters.description_zh:
需要查询的配置，支持查询的配置如下：

- domain\_business\_control：用户配置。

- bot_basic：机器流量管理基础版 （合法爬虫，威胁情报）。

- bot_Advance：机器流量管理高级版（合法爬虫，威胁情报，AI智能防护）。
